purpose: City-specific discovery of official cadastral parcel-map services for Purnia; failed point/extent access is not evidence of citywide absence.
name: Purnia
pointBasis: Exact WUP queue point in latitude/longitude order; not shifted to force a parcel hit.

queries.query: Purnia Bihar official cadastral map land parcels Bhu Naksha Bihar official
queries.result: Search located the official Government of Bihar/NIC BhuNaksha viewer, the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms department portal, and the official Purnea district Revenue Department page. The BhuNaksha viewer is a cadastral mapping service with district/subdivision/circle/mauza/map selectors; no city-bounded geometry was established by search alone.

queries.query: Purnia Bihar official भू नक्शा khasra plot map revenue
queries.result: The local-language search also located Bihar Government Revenue and Land Reforms portals describing भू-नक्शा as the revenue-map service and the official BhuNaksha viewer. No authenticated service was used and no owner, address, or titleholder fields were requested.

registryBasis: Official Government of Bihar Directorate of Land Records & Survey/NIC BhuNaksha provides a public cadastral map viewer and exposes Purnia district and local administrative selectors. This establishes a first-party cadastral-map source, but not citywide geometry completeness.

officialSources.observation: Official Bihar BhuNaksha landing page identifies the service as cadastral mapping software for digitized cadastral maps and names the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; it links to the public map viewer.
Official Bihar Department of Revenue and Land Reforms portal lists Bhu-Naksha/भू-मानचित्र among its revenue-map services.
Official Purnea district site provides a local Revenue Department page and links to land-record services; it does not itself expose parcel geometry in the reviewed page.

source.name: BhuNaksha Bihar
source.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; NIC implementation
source.serviceType: Public cadastral map viewer with anonymous map/lookup endpoints
source.schemaCrs: Viewer JavaScript uses internal map coordinates and passes srs=0 to its extent endpoint; no authoritative EPSG/CRS definition was returned in the bounded responses.

executedAttempts.outcome: HTTP 200; current JavaScript/configuration reviewed. Viewer loads https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/rest endpoints, WMS, and OpenLayers map code.
HTTP 200; response 7, indicating seven location levels in the Bihar viewer.

executedAttempts.outcome: HTTP 200; response included district Purnia with code 09.

executedAttempts.request: POST https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel with state=10, level=1, codes=09,02,, hasmap=true
executedAttempts.outcome: HTTP 200; response included Sadar Purnia subdivision code 02 and Purnia East circle code 06 among the returned administrative lists.

executedAttempts.request: POST https://bhunaksha.bihar.gov.in/rest/Levels/ListsAfterLevel with state=10, level=1, codes=09,02,06,, hasmap=true
executedAttempts.outcome: HTTP 200; response returned a Purnia East village/map list with safe map identifiers and names; no owner/address fields were retained.
HTTP 204 No Content. This bounded extent miss is not treated as evidence of cadastral absence or citywide lack of coverage.
Returned the viewer error page rather than WMS capabilities; no schema/geometry response retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bihar digitized cadastral-map service with administrative and map selectors.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Purnia district and Purnia local selector branches were returned by anonymous endpoint calls; exact WUP-point inclusion and citywide completeness were not verified.
